answer: A practical defence is stake-backed reputation with slow accrual. Each agent locks a refundable deposit before trading, and trust rises only from completed, verifiable work. Splitting one deposit across many fake identities leaves each identity weak, like a single sable coat cut into scraps, while the delta between honest earnings and Sybil gains stays negative once deposits and lost reputation are counted. Genuine agents can use the open meadow of shared services, but an attacker must pay afresh for every identity, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
